about: Stand-in /proc/meminfo, /proc/self/cgroup and cgroup mount files, with the answers every host-memory reader must give: headroom (the least room left under any memory cgroup limit on the path from the process's own cgroup up to its mount), limit (the smallest such limit) and available (MemAvailable capped by the headroom). Held by rw_host_memory, which the renderer reads as rusty_weather::host_memory (cargo test -p rw-host-memory), by the MPAS static builder's rw_mpas::static_memory (cargo test -p rw-mpas), and by tilestream.autoplan and gpuwm.core.preflight.host_available_bytes (tests/test_preflight.py). A null meminfo or proc_self_cgroup is a file that is not there; cgroup maps a path under the mount to its text.
